capabilities: Open named or inline forms from JavaScript and receive the submitted data
Collect input through typed fields including text, number, date, slider, toggle, selects, and note-name autocompletion
Create notes or insert text from templates after form submission
Register command palette commands to trigger forms directly
Format form results as frontmatter YAML, dataview properties, or templated strings
extras: Full documentation is hosted separately via mkdocs; several sections (FormResult details, Dataview integration, template syntax) link out. Installable through BRAT.
intentEvidence: rather than offering an alternative, this plugin is designed as a complement to them
motivation: The author found that Templater and QuickAdd ease creating notes with predefined structure but require manual data entry with limited inputs, so they built a complement offering form-based building blocks for existing workflows.
problem: Obsidian has no convenient way to capture multiple structured fields at once; Templater and QuickAdd prompt for one value at a time, without labels or the ability to skip fields.

relations.evidence: Templater to open modals from templates
QuickAdd to quickly capture data from a modal
dataview to provide values for auto-completion

summary: Plugin that defines reusable modal forms for capturing structured data, callable via a JavaScript API from Templater, QuickAdd, Dataview, or commands.
